description: A shoot's photos: each one's id, whether it is ready, still working or failed (failed photos are refunded), each one's link in the Luala app (the link to give the user), and the shoot's page there; previews of the ready ones once none is working. While photos are working it waits up to 25 seconds for them before answering; call it again until none is working, telling the user how many are ready each time.
name: get_shoot
title: Get a shoot's photos
